name: AWA — American Women's Association
summary: Long-running association for friendship, volunteering, and newcomer orientation — high ROI in the first 90 days for trailing partners.
body: AWA helps arriving partners and professionals plug into interest groups, volunteering, and social circles. In practice it is often broader than ‘Americans only’ — confirm current membership openness. Reddit craft and friendship threads frequently name AWA fortnightly interest groups (crafts hosted in homes, book clubs, volunteer days) as higher-signal than one-off mixers. Frequently recommended alongside Bumble BFF and Meetup when newcomers ask how to meet women friends in male-heavy workplaces, and when trailing spouses want structure without a single Facebook megagroup. Pair with giving.sg for additional volunteer shifts and with ANZA / nationality groups for passport-specific calendars.
membershipNotes: Annual dues; interest groups and volunteering drive the value. Verify live requirements and openness for non-US members.
